S02.reason: Das and Hidayatullah preserved the 1952 ground and dismissed the appeal; Sarkar dissented on section 57.

S03.label: SUPPORTED

S04.label: SUPPORTED

S05.label: SUPPORTED

S09.label: SUPPORTED

S11.label: SUPPORTED

S13.label: SUPPORTED

S16.label: SUPPORTED

S17.label: SUPPORTED

S18.label: SUPPORTED

S19.label: SUPPORTED

S22.label: SUPPORTED
